The '''Mark IX Executioner''' was an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] engineered by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. This [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was distributed on [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]] and was succeeded by the [[Mark X Executioner droid/Legends|Mark X Executioner]] and [[Mark XI Executioner]].

[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Rom Mohc]] defeated a Mark IX Executioner in single combat, and kept its remains in his trophy room.<ref name="Dark">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 1}}</ref>
